turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?

Hi doctor. I have swelling and some pain in my feet—on the right side and top of my foot, and also on the left top and left sole. The pain is about 3/10 and feels heavy/sharp, and it started pretty fast.
Yes, I think so—my main issue is swelling in certain spots, especially on my feet (right lateral and top, and left top and sole).
